ui.s_7c150d36b4: Trained using two-stage fine-tuning with AdamW optimizer, cosine annealing, and heavy data augmentation to combat laboratory background shortcut learning.
ui.s_8f0c87a7dd: Dataset Sources & The Field Generalization Gap
ui.s_ab877d07e7: 54,305 controlled laboratory images across 38 classes. While providing rich morphological coverage, lab images feature uniform single-color backgrounds that can cause models to learn background shortcuts.
ui.s_7afc59bed1: Evaluated against real-world field photographs taken in orchards and farms under variable weather, complex background foliage, and varying light conditions.
ui.s_5a59600e77: Accuracy on clean lab test sets is typically higher than real-world field images due to overlapping leaves, motion blur, and co-infections in nature. Our model implements explicit confidence thresholding and Shannon entropy rejection to flag ambiguous field samples as 'Uncertain' rather than making false confident predictions.
ui.s_2ff168e676: All image uploads are immediately stripped of embedded EXIF camera and GPS metadata on our server before persistence. Coordinates for weather telemetry are processed in-memory or stored with anonymized user accounts only. Retraining datasets are generated strictly with voluntary farmer opt-in consent.
ui.s_825462fc16: This software is an informational tool and does not substitute for certified in-person crop consultants or government plant pathology laboratories.
ui.s_77db47a730: Pesticide active ingredients and controls listed are generic categories. Chemical registrations vary by state and nation. Always read the physical chemical product label and observe Pre-Harvest Intervals (PHI) and Re-Entry Intervals (REI).
ui.s_8a70460c60: Outbreak risk scores are transparent agronomic heuristics combining temperature windows, high-humidity hours, and rainfall proxies. They are advisory estimates, not guaranteed forecasts.
